text:
The College Board is just hypocritical. A friend took the one hour Subject Test, but the proctor accidentally gave the room about twenty extra minutes. She is honest, and she knew that would make the test less standardized. So she called the hotline to report it.
The result was pure institutional injustice. After their "investigation" they said there wasn't enough evidence to blame the proctor or the other students. But then they did find enough evidence to blame my friend, and her scores were voided. Punishing the person who honestly reported the problem and excusing the actual violator? That is how messed up they are.
